ValidationRule.description: Approval Cannot Change the Approval result until Verifier Approves.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Verification_Result__c, 'Approve')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application"), AND(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approval cannot change the Approval result until Credit Verification Result is Approved.
